note: Order matters: 'run' creates results/ which 'field-json' and 'overlay' read. 'overlay' is recorded in an image viewer after the command runs.
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-04 -l westeurope -o none

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-04 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p developerPrincipalId=$me --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'deployment to rg-mglab-ai-04 failed' }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignment propagation (up to 5 minutes)

screens.name: field-json
steps: Open results/01-fabrikam-clean.json in the episode folder
Fold the JSON so documents[0].fields.InvoiceTotal is visible
Pause on type: currency, valueCurrency (amount, currencyCode EUR), content, confidence and boundingRegions with the polygon
mask: none expected (fictional invoice); keep the resource endpoint out of view

screens.name: overlay
steps: In a terminal in the episode folder run: python -m invoice_intake.overlay samples/04-adventure-works-faded.png results/04-adventure-works-faded.json (use 02-northwind-bad-total if 04 was not sent to review)
Open the PNG that the command prints in the image viewer, full screen
Pause on the green boxes (above threshold) and amber boxes (below), with field names and confidences

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-04 -n $env:AI_ACCOUNT -l westeurope
